note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928); original in English; soldier only, worker and alate not described; description based on two mature soldiers and two immature soldiers; figure numbers, localities and the terminal gazetteer of the volume omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Anterior margin of the pronotum only slightly concave; in M. progrediens the pronotal anterior margin is distinctly notched and the sides of the head are more rounded; M. acerbus has a distinctly longer head; M. debilicornis is close but has a longer and narrower head; M. zuluensis is also very close, with the head apparently shorter. Fuller considered records outside Natal unconfirmed and the specimens at hand possibly misidentified, but the description agrees fully with the Garamba specimens, and the syntype soldier also agrees.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, rectangular; sides straight and parallel; posterior margin rounded. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 almost as long as segment 4 but distinctly narrower at the base, segment 2 longer than segment 4. Mandibles reddish brown, inner margin toothed. Anterior margin of the pronotum very weakly notched. Head length (with mandibles) 2.10 mm; head width 0.78 mm; antennal length 1.10 mm; pronotum length 0.26 mm, width 0.50 mm; hind tibia length 0.62 mm; left mandible length 0.82 mm.
